grader.scenario: Mobile Visual Voicemail interface failing to sync audio messages on iPhone 15; resolved via carrier token refresh and IMAP profile reprovisioning
grader.notes: Flawless call featuring deep empathy in middle third, carrier token reprovisioning, harmless recheck in final third, and complete live audio playback verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Wilma throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated profound empathy at turn 22 regarding customer's late sister's estate and High Court probate deadline, and no unhandled outbursts occurred.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the Visual Voicemail synchronization failure at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent executed carrier profile reprovisioning, pushed token reset, locked IMAP settings, and verified live audio playback.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, warm, and highly supportive professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about direct 1571 keypad dialing and carrier update history.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer refreshed the Voicemail tab live on call, saw three message cards, and played the solicitor's audio message perfectly.
